operation: RB-6 re-verification of the two PDF-only prior-7.9 Highway Log rows
verified_by: Claude, 2026-08-31, independently of the Stage-1A audit
method: Each route's raw PDF was re-read through the shipped char-window reader (pdf_table_lib.char_lines at the Highway Log tolerances Y=3 / word gap=1.5) and each Excel sibling through openpyxl. Note the Location PREFIX prints as its OWN token: a first-word match finds route 074's unprefixed 000.000 but MISSES route 101's R022.828, which is why the search is on the joined line. A probe that returns 0 is broken until a positive control says otherwise — route 074 is that control here.

rows.note: The Excel sibling carries no row containing '022.828' in ANY column, not merely none whose Location equals R022.828.

rule: The PDF-derived row universe RETAINS both rows; the Excel-derived universe must never synthesize them. They surface as ONE-SIDED, never paired against an invented partner.
